# AmmarAI

> One AI workspace for everything you create — writing, chat, images, video, voiceovers, transcription, document analysis and code across 151 tools. Brand voice, templates, assistants, bulk generation and team workspaces in one place. Free plan available.

## AI Tools
- [AI Agent Builder](https://ammarai.com/ai-agent-builder): Build agents that run real workflows on a schedule or trigger — reading, deciding and acting without you.
- [AI Phone Call Agent](https://ammarai.com/ai-phone-agent): A voice agent that answers and makes real phone calls, books appointments and logs every conversation.
- [AI CRM](https://ammarai.com/ai-crm): A CRM you talk to: ask about the pipeline, update deals and get reports without touching a spreadsheet.
- [AI Social Media Agent](https://ammarai.com/ai-social-media-agent): An agent that plans, writes, schedules and adjusts a month of social posts across your accounts.
- [AI Blogger Agent](https://ammarai.com/ai-blogger-agent): An agent that researches keywords, writes SEO articles in bulk and publishes them to your blog on a schedule.
- [AI DM & Comment Agent](https://ammarai.com/ai-dm-comment-agent): Auto-reply to Instagram, Facebook and YouTube comments and DMs, capture leads and run campaign promotions.
- [AI Deep Research](https://ammarai.com/ai-deep-research): Multi-source research runs with live web search, compiled into a clear, cited report.
- [UGC Factory](https://ammarai.com/ugc-factory): Produce creator-style videos at volume with virtual actors, digital twins, voiceover and lip-synced delivery.
- [Viral Clips](https://ammarai.com/viral-clips): Turn one long video into a set of short vertical clips built for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
- [AI Video Enhancer](https://ammarai.com/ai-video-enhancer): Upscale and restore video frame by frame for sharper detail and a higher output resolution.
- [AI Council Mode](https://ammarai.com/ai-council-mode): Ask several AI models the same question at once and compare their answers side by side, or merge them into one.
- [AI Social Media Publisher](https://ammarai.com/ai-social-media-publisher): Preview, schedule and publish posts to Facebook, Instagram, X and LinkedIn from one calendar.
- [Content Manager](https://ammarai.com/content-manager): One library for everything you upload and generate — images, documents and video, searchable and reusable.
- [AI ReWriter](https://ammarai.com/ai-rewriter): Rewrite existing text in a different tone, length or reading level while keeping the meaning intact.
- [Brand Voice](https://ammarai.com/brand-voice): Define how your brand sounds once, and have every writing tool follow it.
- [AI Editor](https://ammarai.com/ai-editor): A long-form document editor with AI help built into the page, for drafting and revising in one place.
- [AI Image Assistant](https://ammarai.com/ai-image-assistant): Guided prompt help inside image generation — suggestions, refinements and follow-up edits in plain language.
- [AI Realtime Image](https://ammarai.com/ai-realtime-image): Watch the image redraw as you type — change a word and see the result instantly, with no submit and wait.
- [AI Personas & Skills](https://ammarai.com/ai-personas): Build reusable AI personas with their own role, tone, knowledge and skills, then use them anywhere in the workspace instead of retyping instructions.
- [AI Command Search](https://ammarai.com/ai-command-search): One search box that finds the right tool, opens past work and starts the job — type what you want in plain language and press enter.
- [AI Smart Inbox](https://ammarai.com/ai-smart-inbox): One inbox for every conversation — website chat, email, social DMs and comments — triaged, tagged and answered by AI.
- [AI Marketing Bot](https://ammarai.com/ai-marketing-bot): Broadcast marketing messages to your WhatsApp and Telegram audiences — written by AI, segmented, scheduled and measured.
- [AI Image Editor](https://ammarai.com/ai-image-editor): Edit a photo by describing the change — swap the background, remove objects, extend the frame, fix the light.
- [AI Product Photoshoot](https://ammarai.com/ai-photoshoot): Turn one plain product photo into a full commercial shoot — studio, lifestyle and seasonal scenes.
- [AI Fashion Studio](https://ammarai.com/ai-virtual-try-on): Put a garment on a model without a shoot — same clothes, real fit, any model, any setting.
- [AI Creative Suite](https://ammarai.com/ai-creative-suite): A drag-and-drop design editor with AI image generation — ads, social posts, invitations and banners that all match.
- [AI Video Editor](https://ammarai.com/ai-video-editor): Upload footage and describe the finished cut you want, from pacing and colour to transitions and sound.
- [AI Captions](https://ammarai.com/ai-captions): Turn spoken video into accurately timed, styled captions ready for social platforms and accessible playback.
- [AI Dubbing](https://ammarai.com/ai-dubbing): Translate spoken video into new languages with natural voices, matched timing and a finished localised video.
- [AI UGC Creator](https://ammarai.com/ai-ugc-generator): Create authentic creator-style product videos from a brief, complete with hook, demonstration and call to action.
- [AI YouTube & Shorts Publisher](https://ammarai.com/ai-youtube-publisher): Turn source footage into a packaged YouTube video or Short with edit, title, description, thumbnail direction and schedule.
- [AI Writer](https://ammarai.com/ai-writer): A flexible writing workspace for drafts, long-form articles, rewrites, and brand-consistent content. Includes templates, the Article Wizard, Smart Editor, and tone controls so every piece stays on-brand.
- [AI Chat Pro](https://ammarai.com/ai-chat): A multi-model chat with personas, reusable skills, smart memory, live web search, file uploads and organised folders — and it hands finished work to the rest of the platform.
- [AI Image Pro](https://ammarai.com/ai-image-generator): A full image studio: generate from text, edit with a brush, keep one character or style consistent, swap backgrounds, upscale and export every size you need.
- [AI Video Pro](https://ammarai.com/ai-video-generator): Create short videos from text prompts or still images. Includes text-to-video, image-to-video, smooth transitions, and options for captions and voiceover.
- [AI Voiceover & Voice Clone](https://ammarai.com/ai-voice-generator): Generate natural-sounding voiceovers in 150+ languages and dialects. Clone your own voice or choose from a large library of neural voices, with control over tone, speed, and emotion.
- [AI Text to Speech](https://ammarai.com/ai-text-to-speech): Convert articles, documents and scripts into clear spoken audio, at length and at speed.
- [AI Speech to Text](https://ammarai.com/ai-speech-to-text): Fast, accurate conversion of speech into text, including live dictation and recorded audio.
- [AI Transcription](https://ammarai.com/ai-transcription): Accurately transcribe audio and video files into text with speaker labels and timestamps. Supports multiple languages and common audio formats.
- [AI Avatar Video Generator](https://ammarai.com/ai-avatar-generator): Turn any image into a talking avatar video with realistic lip-sync and natural expressions. Ideal for product explainers, social content, training videos, and personal branding.
- [AI Image to Video](https://ammarai.com/ai-image-to-video): Animate a still image into a short clip with camera movement and controlled motion.
- [AI Code Generator](https://ammarai.com/ai-code-generator): Generate code in multiple languages from natural language descriptions — functions, components, queries and tests, with explanations you can review.
- [AI Vision](https://ammarai.com/ai-vision): Analyze images, chat with uploaded documents, or analyze any webpage — describe, extract text, compare, and question what you point it at.
- [AI Document Analyzer](https://ammarai.com/ai-document-analyzer): Chat with uploaded documents — PDF, Word, CSV — and get summaries, answers with citations, and extracted structured data.

## Platform Features
- [Multi-model AI](https://ammarai.com/features/multi-model-ai): Each task runs on a model suited to it, without you managing providers.
- [Brand voice](https://ammarai.com/features/brand-voice): Save tone, vocabulary and rules once and reuse them across every writing tool.
- [Templates library](https://ammarai.com/features/templates-library): Proven starting structures for common formats, plus your own saved templates.
- [Bulk generation](https://ammarai.com/features/bulk-generation): Run one structure across hundreds of rows for catalogue-scale output.
- [File uploads](https://ammarai.com/features/file-uploads): Upload documents, images and audio so output is grounded in your own material.
- [Custom AI assistants](https://ammarai.com/features/ai-assistants): Assistants with a fixed brief and reference material for recurring work.
- [Team workspaces](https://ammarai.com/features/team-workspaces): Shared brand assets and history so team output stays consistent.
- [History and versions](https://ammarai.com/features/history-and-versions): Every generation saved, searchable and restorable.
- [Export and integrations](https://ammarai.com/features/export-and-integrations): Clean exports in the formats your publishing workflow already uses.
- [Privacy and control](https://ammarai.com/features/privacy-and-control): Ownership of your output, control over your data, honest limits.

## Use Cases
- [AI for Marketing Teams](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-marketing): Turn a single campaign brief into ads, emails, and landing pages without the usual back-and-forth.
- [AI for Content Creators](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-content-creators): Turn one video or post idea into scripts, captions, and titles without losing a whole afternoon to it.
- [AI for Small Business](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-small-business): Write website copy, ads, and customer emails yourself, without hiring an agency you can't yet afford.
- [AI for Entrepreneurs](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-entrepreneurs): Turn a new idea into a landing page, pitch copy, and outreach emails fast enough to actually test it.
- [AI for Students](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-students): Summarize readings, brainstorm outlines, and check grammar — as study support, not a way to submit work you didn't write.
- [AI for Developers](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-developers): Generate boilerplate, draft documentation, and explain technical work without switching out of flow.
- [AI for Agencies](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-agencies): Produce deliverables across multiple client accounts at once, without hiring at the same pace as new business.
- [AI for E-commerce](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-ecommerce): Write product descriptions, titles, and listing copy across a whole catalog without hiring a copywriter per SKU.
- [AI for Social Media Managers](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-social-media): Draft captions, hashtags, and post ideas across platforms so the calendar never runs empty mid-month.
- [AI for SEO Professionals](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-seo): Produce optimized blog posts, meta descriptions, and FAQ content at the volume organic growth actually requires.
- [AI for Personal Productivity](https://ammarai.com/ai-for-productivity): Draft emails, summarize documents, and clear routine writing tasks faster, so the backlog stops growing.
- [AI Marketing Video Maker](https://ammarai.com/ai-marketing-video-maker): Create campaign, ad and explainer video concepts from a brief in one connected workflow.
- [AI Product Demo Video Maker](https://ammarai.com/ai-product-demo-video-maker): Build on-camera or scene-led product demonstrations from a focused product brief.

- [AI Customer Support Agent](https://ammarai.com/ai-customer-support-agent): Triage requests, answer from approved knowledge and hand sensitive conversations to people.
